description: This file defines the CaseFeed class which extends FeedLogicBase. It implements a method pushFeed to generate and push feed updates related to 'Cases', such as case creation and closure, within the SuiteCRM application. The class manages notifications when a case is created or closed, assembling message text based on the case's attributes and invoking SugarFeed::pushFeed2 to send the feed.

classes.name: CaseFeed
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and pushing feed updates related to cases within SuiteCRM. Extends FeedLogicBase and overrides or utilizes its functionality to notify about case creation and status changes.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Generates a textual feed message about a case creation or closure event and pushes it to the feed using SugarFeed::pushFeed2. It determines the message based on whether the case is newly created or closed, retrieving related account information when necessary.
